rule_R2prime.text: adopt four inner folds for m in {8, 16} iff q_a > 0 for at least 5 of the 6 arms AND min_a q_a > -ln(1.02); otherwise keep 2. q_a = median over pooled pseudo-test conditions of ln(S_a,2-fold / S_a,4-fold), S = ensemble (5-seed mean forecast) condition score
